_note: L2Q-01 right-panel parity surface config. floors = minimum count of visible interactive fields (input/select/button) inside the ACTIVE .rp-section after its rail click (measured baseline minus headroom, tab-census convention: paragraph 7, table 9, image 12, chart 7, mailmerge 3 measured 2026-11-08). ooAnchors = OO deep census rightPanel.openedSections group anchors (census-oo-deep.json) that must have a WO counterpart label; each anchor tethers to a census heading and carries substring aliases for morphological tolerance (OO 'Indents' vs WO 'Indent left (pt)', OO 'Rotation' vs WO 'Rotate 90°'). An anchor is matched when any alias is a substring of a WO .rp-title/label/button/option text (or vice versa), case-insensitive, across the 5 sections. Missing mandatory anchors FAIL the surface; optional ones are reported only.
